name: Tsuma Shiri ~Boku ga Bitch Hitozuma o Otosu made~
original_name: 妻尻～僕がビッチ人妻を落とすまで～
source:
Every day was the same at the teahouse.

I worked part-time under a demure married woman.
One day we had a very unusual encounter.

My yearning for her exploded.
I didn't have any interest in her baby hole! 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE097205.html]DLsite English[/url]]
